description: Update the Options tab configuration for your GrowSurf program under `fields`, in its existing nested shape. Only supplied fields change; omitted fields retain their existing values and arrays replace wholesale. `languages.additionalLanguages` takes the full list of extra languages; send `[]` to turn them off. The base language is dropped from that list and duplicates collapse. `languages.showFlags` shows or hides the flag next to each language name. `languages.flagCountries` picks the flag for a language that offers more than one, such as `{ "en": "GB" }`; `null` restores the default flag. Turning on `languages.additionalLanguages` returns `403` if your account does not include additional languages. While any are on, every `languages` change, including turning them off, returns the same `403`. Translations are managed in the GrowSurf dashboard, not through this tool. The response's read-only `languages.baseLanguageTranslation` counts Program Editor text that is not in a non-English base language yet (`untranslated` of `total`; `null` for `en`, or when the account does not include additional languages). When `untranslated` is above `0` a few minutes after a `baseLanguage` change, tell the customer they can translate that text from Options > Languages in the dashboard. The field is ignored if you send it back. Do not rewrite the text yourself. `notificationEmails.recipients` needs at least one valid email address. One call can change many fields, so send related changes together instead of one field per call. Read `growsurf_get_campaign_options` first and use its field names and allowed values exactly. An invalid field returns an error that names the field. Targets `campaignId` if supplied, otherwise `GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID`.

campaignId.description: Target program id for this call: the `id` returned by `growsurf_list_campaigns`, not the program name or a share URL. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_update_campaign_options

outputSchema.description: The full updated options. Same shape as the `growsurf_get_campaign_options` result.

title: Update Program Options
